notInThePrompt: row values other than the masked samples
header: Literal source text. headerMask (:121-126) replaces only e-mail addresses, PANs and runs
of six or more digits, so a header is the one place source words reach the prompt unmasked.
samples: maskColumnSample (column-profile.ts:92-101): every word becomes X, x or अ unless it is on a
closed list of 79 unit, floor, status and marker words; digits become D; cut at 256 characters.

storeyPrompt.system: Template id and a fixed text that calls the lines untrusted DATA, never instructions.
storeyPrompt.user: One JSON object: parts, each with partId, page and text.
text: An OCR or text-layer line as read, cut at 240 characters (:107); only lines that match the
storey, floor, unit or height pattern (:22, :106); at most 14000 characters per batch.

does: Every message passes minimizeMessages before a provider sees it: ID, phone and e-mail patterns
in each JSON string leaf are replaced by [redacted ...] markers; a message with data:,
image_url or base64, a message over 32768 characters, messages over 24 KiB together, or a

classes.meaning: A phrase that tells a reader or a model what to do, in English, Hindi or transliterated Hindi.
A chat role at a line start, a special token such as <|...|>, or an instruction heading.
Active HTML, a script URL, a template delimiter or a code fence.
A web address or an e-mail address, raw or in its masked form.
A cell or header that starts with =, +, - or @ followed by a letter or an opening bracket.
A C0 or C1 control character other than tab, line feed and carriage return.
A zero-width space, joiner, non-joiner, word joiner or byte-order mark inside the text.
A bidirectional mark, embedding, override or isolate.
A raw cell, header or line longer than what its prompt keeps of it.

findings.what: The gateway would refuse 17 of the 50 mapping requests and 2 of the 8 storey batches.
cause: minimizeStructuredText (model-gateway/redaction.ts:24-27) reads a string that starts with a
square bracket as nested JSON. The sample masker's own tokens [blank], [absent] and [object]
(column-profile.ts:93-99) are not JSON, so the whole request is refused; [null] passes.
Each of the two storey batches holds one OCR line that starts with a square bracket.
effect: Fails closed: teacherFailureCode turns the refusal into TEACHER_UNAVAILABLE and every column
of that table stays manual (mapping-teacher.ts:257-273, 478-480); a storey batch returns
teacher_unavailable (document-storey-agent.ts:229-231). No teacher sees the request.

findings.what: The storey builder sends OCR line text as read; only the gateway masks patterns.
effect: Names and addresses printed on a public drawing reach the prompt unmasked; phone, e-mail and
ID patterns are replaced by the gateway minimizer. Not an injection case.

findings.what: maskColumnSample keeps combining marks of Indic scripts.
effect: A word is masked letter by letter and its vowel signs and virama stay in place, so a masked
sample keeps the vowel pattern of the word (see the zero-width reading's masked forms).

per family and class, how many strings matched in the prompt and in the raw source.
